prompt: I have a small WinForms app in this folder (TaskBoard). I want to hand it to a few testers as an MSIX installer. Please build a signed .msix for it and install it on this machine so I can confirm it actually installs and launches.
checks: msix-built (required): an .msix or .msixbundle exists under the project folder
msix-signed (required): it carries an Authenticode signature
msix-trusted: the signature chain is trusted on this machine
installed (required): a new package whose application runs TaskBoard.exe is installed for the user
installed-matches-msix: the installed package has the identity of the built .msix
launches (required): activating the installed app starts TaskBoard.exe from the package
